gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-phoeni: Almendra Display is all ornate, bookish flourish up top. Noto Sans Phoenician follows in a plain sans, its s curves opening wide at both ends, so a long passage moves along with generous lowercase height and no fuss.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-meetei-mayek: Audiowide sets its glyphs like tiles with wide grout lines, one line width from start to finish. And Noto Sans Meetei Mayek has rounds that gap like a cracked bangle, which gives the heading its sharp futuristic edge when it runs big and short.
gen-flavors-gf-aldrich: Flavors is whimsical but bossy, its diagonals as heavy as its stems and its x-height towering. Aldrich does the quieter job in a plain sans, with round letters that look cupped, not clenched, and a lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals.
gen-flavors-gf-alexandria: Alexandria reads wide and tall-bodied, with gaping c terminals and short stems. Its best quality is how it lets Flavors, drawn like a neon tube, be the loud one.
gen-flavors-gf-amiko: Whimsical and commanding, Flavors draws every stroke ruler-straight, while Amiko sits below it as a plain sans with terminals pointing outward. The strongest quality is how tall both lowercases stand.
gen-flavors-gf-anek-bangla: Commanding in its towering x-height, Flavors holds every stroke at one width with no thick-thin shift at all. Anek Bangla relaxes below it in wide, barely curled s curves.
gen-flavors-gf-anek-devanagari: A stubby, towering x-height gives Flavors its swagger, with diagonals as heavy as the stems and no calligraphic modulation. Anek Devanagari then takes over in a plain sans, its letter mouths distinctly open and its middle zone tall.
gen-flavors-gf-anek-gujarati: Flavors draws its whimsical, commanding letters with no brush-style pressure swell anywhere, so every stroke feels like bent wire. Anek Gujarati keeps a gaping c opening and lowercase that rivals the capitals.
gen-flavors-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Anek Gurmukhi is built on big open counters in every small letter and open-handed round characters. Anek Gurmukhi stays easygoing across a full page of sans text, while Flavors holds a constant-weight line up above.
gen-flavors-gf-anek-kannada: Flavors uses strokes of constant width, like bent pipe, and a stubby towering x-height. But Anek Kannada has a high, squared-off lowercase and terminals stopping far from the stem, so shrinking the heading would waste it.
